note: Shared INPUT for the EPIC-13 aggregation + wide-projection parity fixture. Both suites build AggregateInputRow objects and a MetricDefinition map from this file, run MetricAggregator + WideCSVProjector, and must produce records-hint-v1.csv / records-minavgmax-v1.csv / wide-v1.csv byte for byte (goldens in this folder). Read by apps/ios/Tests/GPXAggregationParityTests.swift and apps/android/app/src/test/java/net/albayyan/badan/GpxAggregationParityTest.kt. Numbers are strings so both platforms parse them through the correctly-rounded Double(String)/String.toDouble() path (same reasoning as packages/fixtures/export/README.md); timestamps are epoch-millis strings.

coverage.dst-spring: activity.steps/distance/floors/respiratory.rate on 2026-03-08 in America/New_York — a 23-hour spring-forward day; bucket_end - bucket_start must be 82800000 ms
coverage.dst-fall: activity.steps on 2026-11-01 in America/New_York — a 25-hour fall-back day; bucket_end - bucket_start must be 90000000 ms
coverage.tz-change: heart.hr rows recorded 2026-06-20 08:00 in Asia/Dubai and 2026-06-20 20:00 in America/New_York share the local date 2026-06-20 and land in ONE bucket; contributing_tzs = America/New_York;Asia/Dubai; boundaries anchored in the earliest row's zone (Asia/Dubai, a 24h day); a third row on 2026-06-21 is a separate bucket
coverage.default-stat-path-1: activity.distance rows all carry storedAggregation=sum (agree) -> sum; respiratory.rate rows all carry mean -> mean (a rate, so path 2 would not fire)
coverage.default-stat-path-2: activity.steps has no storedAggregation -> intervalAggregate + cumulative unit 'count' -> sum
coverage.default-stat-path-3: heart.hr is a rawSample in bpm (a rate) -> mean
coverage.default-stat-fallthrough: activity.floors rows carry sum and max (disagree) -> fall through to path 2 (count is cumulative) -> sum
coverage.decimal-render: heart.hr 2026-06-20 mean of 62 and 79 = 70.5 exercises non-integer decimal rendering; respiratory.rate mean of 14 and 16 = 15 stays integer
coverage.duration-latest: activity.distance rows carry endMs (3600s each) so a duration run totals 7200 and a latest run yields 1500 — asserted directly in the suites, not goldened
